title: Advisors: Memory, RAG, Logging
objective: After this lesson you will be able to chain advisors in semantic order (memory → RAG → logging), pass CONVERSATION_ID correctly, scope QuestionAnswerAdvisor retrieval, and instrument with SimpleLoggerAdvisor at DEBUG.
why: Advisors are Spring AI's interception layer: cross-cutting prompt enrichment without tangling business code. Order is semantics (memory before RAG so searches see history), IDs are mandatory (CONVERSATION_ID every memory call), and logging is debuggability. Misordered advisors silently degrade (follow-ups searching blind); missing IDs fail loudly at runtime.

blocks.text: Advisors execute in registration order, each transforming shared prompt state: `MessageChatMemoryAdvisor` (inject history) → `QuestionAnswerAdvisor` (retrieve with enriched query) → `SimpleLoggerAdvisor` (log final prompt + response) → `ToolCallingAdvisor` (auto, positioned by order property). Reversed memory/RAG order searches bare follow-ups ('blue?' searches blue, not shoes). Order deliberately, document why inline.

blocks.code:
chatClient.prompt()
    .advisors(a -> a
        .advisors(
            MessageChatMemoryAdvisor.builder(chatMemory).build(),
            QuestionAnswerAdvisor.builder(vectorStore).build(),
            new SimpleLoggerAdvisor())
        .param(ChatMemory.CONVERSATION_ID, conversationId))
    .user(userText).call().content();
// Memory enriches → RAG searches enriched → logger records final. Omit the ID param: IllegalArgumentException.

blocks.text: Memory advisors key history by conversation: the ID param is **mandatory per call** (runtime exception otherwise), stable per user-thread (UUIDs, not incrementing counters shared across users), and logged with traces (which conversation misbehaved?). Missing IDs fail fast (good); shared IDs across users leak histories (catastrophic — test isolation explicitly).

`SimpleLoggerAdvisor` logs advised requests + responses; constructor variants customize mapping and order; package level `logging.level.org.springframework.ai.chat.client.advisor=DEBUG` gates output. Log prompts/responses in dev/staging freely; scrub PII before production logging (advisor-mapped custom functions that redact). Unlogged advisor chains debug by imagination.

blocks.title: Order the chain
blocks.note: Run it: expect memory,rag,logger with true — then logger,tools with false (no memory/RAG present: indexOf -1 < -1 is false, correctly signaling absence, not order). Ordering proves semantics; absence proves nothing.

items: Advisor order is semantics: memory → RAG → logging (+ tool advisor positioned) — document why inline
CONVERSATION_ID mandatory per call, stable per thread, isolation-tested across users
SimpleLoggerAdvisor + DEBUG level + PII scrubbing: debuggability without leakage

exercise.prompt: (a) Run the practice orderer on both inputs and explain the false in case two. (b) Write the follow-up failure without memory-first (bare 'blue?' retrieval) vs fixed, as two advisor lists. (c) State the PII rule for advisor logs in production (what gets scrubbed, where).
hints: Case one orders correctly (memory,rag,logger, true). Case two: logger,tools with false — absence, not misorder (no memory/RAG to compare).
Broken: [rag] alone on 'blue?' (searches color). Fixed: [memory, rag] (history enriches to shoes before search).
Scrub PII in custom request/response mappers pre-log; eval datasets scrubbed identically; raw ticket text never in DEBUG prod logs.
exercise.why: Absence-vs-misorder distinction (false means nothing to compare), order-as-semantics (follow-up proof), and scrub-before-log (PII discipline) are the three advisor judgments.
exercise.code: // Advisor-order pattern: memory → RAG → logging, documented inline.

options: Memory advisor before RAG advisor: history enriches queries pre-retrieval
quiz.explain: Order is semantics: RAG on bare follow-ups searches fragments. Memory-first carries conversation into retrieval.

options: Missing ChatMemory.CONVERSATION_ID param — mandatory per call
quiz.explain: Fail-fast by design: no ID, no history scoping possible. Stable per-thread IDs, isolation-tested.

quiz.q: Production DEBUG logs with ticket PII. Fix?
options: Custom request/response mappers scrubbing PII pre-log; eval sets scrubbed identically
quiz.explain: Debuggability without leakage: scrub in mappers before persistence. Raw PII in logs violates retention silently.

summary: Memory → RAG → logging (+ tools positioned), IDs mandatory and isolated, logs DEBUG-gated and scrubbed. Order documents itself inline.
